title: Daily Standup: Cập nhật tiến độ rõ ràng
summary: Luyện một quy ước nhóm để báo cáo tiến độ hướng tới Sprint Goal, priority và blocker có next action trong 60 giây.
learningObjectives: Nêu tiến độ liên quan tới Sprint Goal

sections.title: A concise team update
sections.content: Sprint Goal: make signup and payment ready for partner beta. Yesterday: completed signup validation and tests. Today: deploy to staging and investigate payment timeout. Blocker: payment dashboard access; platform team has the request; fallback is pairing with Linh.

provenance.adaptationNote: Names, metrics, tickets and incidents are fictional training data. The three-part update is a team convention, not a Scrum requirement.

exercises.question: Which update names a blocker and next action?
options: Payment dashboard access is blocking comparison, so I asked Platform for permission.
correctAnswer: Payment dashboard access is blocking comparison, so I asked Platform for permission.
exercises.explanation: A useful blocker names what is missing, its effect and the action.

performanceTask.title: Deliver a concise Daily Standup
performanceTask.scenario: Tình huống mô phỏng: bạn cập nhật cho một distributed engineering team bằng quy ước ba phần của nhóm.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, dùng quy ước nhóm yesterday, today và blocker mà chưa xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, dùng facts chính: Sprint Goal progress, completed outcome, priority/expected result, blocker impact và next action.
performanceTask.modelResponse: We are moving toward the partner-beta Sprint Goal. Yesterday, I completed signup validation and tests. Today, I will deploy to staging and reproduce the payment timeout. Dashboard access is blocking the comparison, so I asked Platform and will pair with Linh if access is delayed.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, dùng search-index case mới và sửa criterion cần tập trung.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, không xem model/chunks: cập nhật incident 503 với plan, estimate và collaborator.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, từ brief mới, deliver a concise standup linked to the Sprint Goal, with no blocker and one risk.

rubric.label: Three-part team convention
rubric.description: The listener can connect the update to the Sprint Goal and separate completed work, next priority and blocker status. This scaffold is not a Scrum requirement.

rubric.label: Technical specificity
rubric.description: Names a concrete feature, service, test, environment or metric.

rubric.label: Actionable blocker
rubric.description: States impact and next action, or clearly confirms no blocker.

audio.text: Yesterday, I completed the validation tests.
Today, I will reproduce the timeout.
My blocker is access to the payment dashboard.
If access is delayed, I will pair with Linh.

training.question: Which section is this?
training.feedback: Stress YESTERDAY and the completed result.

audio.text: Today, I will deploy and monitor error rates.

training.question: What is included?
training.feedback: Keep deploy and monitor as clear action verbs.

audio.text: I am blocked by missing test credentials.

training.question: What is the blocker?
training.feedback: Make BLOCKED and TEST CREDENTIALS prominent.

audio.text: I asked QA for access and will use a mock account meanwhile.

training.question: What makes this actionable?
training.feedback: Link request and fallback in separate thought groups.

audio.text: I have no blockers at the moment.

training.question: What status is reported?
training.feedback: Say no blockers explicitly when true.

audio.text: My estimate is one day after the test data arrives.

training.question: What condition affects the estimate?
training.feedback: Keep the condition attached to the estimate.

audio.text: Yesterday, I finished the feature flag cleanup.
Today, I will verify five hundred beta accounts.
Meanwhile, I will use a local mock account.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn YESTERDAY, TODAY, BLOCKER để người nghe định vị ba phần.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Thiếu signpost khiến update ngắn vẫn khó theo dõi.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Giữ âm cuối trong tests, logs, blockers; nhấn action verb và object.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Mất plural hoặc action làm scope/blocker không rõ.

modelAudio.text: Yesterday, I completed validation, which closed the main error cases.
